title: Photo Duo 085 · 아워글래스 USSBBW × 텐트폴 USSBBW · 눕기 + 걸터앉기
prompt:
Image format: a horizontal landscape-orientation photograph, 3:2 aspect ratio, wider than it is tall.

A photograph of TWO women in a bare gallery space with a plain smooth deep-charcoal wall behind them, nothing in the frame but one short backless bench carved from a solid block of pale grey stone, just long enough for the two of them and no longer, the camera set close at bench level so the two of them fill the frame edge to edge, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subjects: TWO real adult women, both far beyond any real person in size, one lying on her side along the near length of the stone with her head at the left edge, the other sitting upright on the right end of the same bench with her hips overhanging the narrow stone on both sides and rising to fill the full height of the picture, their two bodies together filling the frame from edge to edge and top to bottom with almost no empty backdrop left.

Lying woman, head at the left: a Korean woman in her late 30s, warm ivory skin with a golden undertone, her face exactly the same tone as her body, tight cornrows in a thick low bun. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size — the one place on her body where the outline pulls inward. Below it an immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and, even as she lies on her side, spills forward away from her body and hangs over the front edge of her torso, the lowest part sagging onto the platform in three or four heavy rounded folds with deep creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, merging seamlessly into her sides, hips and thighs with no boundary anywhere, not pregnant. Colossal hips more than three times the width of that waistline and a gigantic rear, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist. Her upper hip rises as a great rounded mound higher than her own shoulder, the underside hip and thigh flattening wide against the platform. Painted in Chinese Cizhou sgraffito — a glossy jet-black glaze carved away to bold cream-white peony scrolls and leafy vines, carved cream bands following every deep crease and curve.

Seated woman at the right: a South Asian woman in her late 50s, rich warm brown skin with golden undertones, her face exactly the same tone as her body, a sleek low ponytail at the nape. A giant hourglass frame flaring out at both ends: enormous flaring lats spreading to shoulders twice the width of a normal woman's, huge thick arms pushed far out by the width of her back, a colossal bust projecting past the line of her shoulders, no waist at all. A great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and settles down over her thighs as she sits, spreading forward and outward under its own weight in two or three heavy rounded folds with deep creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, merging seamlessly into her sides, hips and thighs with no boundary anywhere, not pregnant. Below it colossal wide hips just as broad as her shoulders and a huge rounded rear; the muscle is rounded and soft-edged under a thick layer of fat. Her hips spread wide and flatten against the seat, the flesh of her thighs bulging out above and below where the hard front edge presses into them. Painted in Russian Palekh miniature — a deep black ground with fine gold linework and jewel-toned firebirds, horses and winter forests in crimson, emerald and ultramarine, a gold border band following every curve.

The lying woman rests her head on her raised hand with that elbow planted behind her body, her other arm lifted clear on the top of her hip with the elbow raised; the seated woman's hands rest on the stone beside her hips. On both: real photographic skin with visible pores, creases where the flesh folds and faint stretch marks, no illustration finish, no CG sheen. The paint is pigment on living skin, distorting over every bulge and cracking where it folds, covering everything below the jaw with no bare skin left; their faces unpainted, the pattern fading out at the neck. Neither arm crosses in front of her own body or the other woman's, both faces toward the camera. Every fold keeps its own rounded outline with a deep crease between them, never one shapeless mass; arms, hands and legs in correct proportion. Both wear extreme platform stiletto heels with soles as tall as their ankle bones.

Horizontal 3:2 landscape-orientation photograph, wider than it is tall.
